trials.summary: trial_01 (first warm-up uniform draw: sigma_ref 10.8, lr_mu 16.4, lr_gamma 0.79, gamma_anneal 0.35; n_runs=n_iter=100) ran the 8-experiment benchmark in 21.8 min: objective 0.0016 +/- 0.0010, mu rel-RMSE 5.6 percent, gamma rel-RMSE 1.4 percent.
trials.key_insight: The warm-up draw already recovers gamma to 1.4 percent and mu to 5.6 percent relative RMSE, with the only visible residual being the two low-count Trans05 experiments where mu lands about 10 to 11 percent low.

trials.summary: trial_02 (uniform warm-up draw: sigma_ref 8.79, lr_mu 16.74, lr_gamma 0.496, gamma_anneal 0.244; n_runs=100, n_iter=10 mechanism test, NOT the campaign budget) ran the 8-experiment benchmark in 6.5 min: objective 0.0537 +/- 0.0149, mu rel-RMSE 31.1 percent, gamma rel-RMSE 10.4 percent.
trials.key_insight: With n_iter=10 the optimizer is far from converged (mu biased about -31 percent on every experiment); this run only demonstrates the mechanism.
